title: Robot wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#cfe8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8fbfe0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='visorGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#2b1a4a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3d2a66'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1='50' y1='18' x2='50' y2='28' stroke='#ffd24d' stroke-width='3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='15' r='4.5' fill='#ff6f91'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <rect x='22' y='26' width='56' height='44' rx='12' fill='url(#bodyGrad)' stroke='#a8d4f0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <rect x='13' y='40' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#7fbde3'/>
  <rect x='80' y='40' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#7fbde3'/>
  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x='29' y='33' width='42' height='30' rx='7' fill='url(#visorGrad)'/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x='32' y='42' width='14' height='9' rx='3.5' fill='#1b1030' stroke='#8a6fe0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <rect x='54' y='42' width='14' height='9' rx='3.5' fill='#1b1030' stroke='#8a6fe0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <rect x='45' y='45' width='10' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#8a6fe0'/>
  <rect x='28' y='43' width='4' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#8a6fe0'/>
  <rect x='68' y='43' width='4' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#8a6fe0'/>
  <!-- glint on lenses -->
  <rect x='35' y='44' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#a894f5'/>
  <rect x='57' y='44' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#a894f5'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 56 Q50 61 58 56' stroke='#57e6b0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='30' y='70' width='40' height='22' rx='7' fill='#9ccdec' stroke='#b8dff5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- chest light -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='81' r='5' fill='#ffd24d' stroke='#ffb84d' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- shoulders -->
  <rect x='20' y='72' width='8' height='6' rx='3' fill='#7fbde3'/>
  <rect x='72' y='72' width='8' height='6' rx='3' fill='#7fbde3'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='34' y='91' width='12' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#6aaed6'/>
  <rect x='54' y='91' width='12' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#6aaed6'/>
</svg>
